newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel economic chiefs to meet on proposed reform.
newsitem.headline: Israel economic chiefs to meet on proposed reform.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Finance Minister Yaacov Neeman and Bank of Israel Governor Jacob Frenkel will meet later on Tuesday to discuss structural changes in the economy, the Treasury said.
This is the second time the parties will meet on the subject, and at the centre of discussions will be a 300-page document containing more than 100 proposals for changes to be implemented in 1998.
The proposals include the communications, transport and energy sectors, Treasury officials said.
No decision is expected to be taken at the end of the meeting.
The proposals, requested by Netanyahu in an effort to restore economic growth in 1998, are due to be brought to the cabinet for discussion on Sunday.
